body:
Lodestones have been used for centuries in manifestation, prosperity, and protection rituals, thanks to their unique ability to magnetize and amplify energy. They work as a powerful conduit between your intentions and the physical world, helping to turn your desires into tangible outcomes.

Lodestones & Money Rituals – Attract Prosperity & Success
If you’re looking to draw wealth, financial stability, or career success, a lodestone is an essential tool. It’s often paired with a green or gold candle and enhanced with our Fast Money Oil to magnetize abundance, luck, and new opportunities into your life.

How to Use:

  • Anoint a green candle with Fast Money Oil and set it beside your lodestone.
  • Light the candle and visualize money, success, and financial breakthroughs flowing toward you.
  • Keep the lodestone on your altar or cash drawer to continuously attract prosperity.

Lodestones & Love Rituals – Deepen Connections & Invite Romance
Lodestones aren’t just for abundance—they are also used to magnetize love, strengthen relationships, and deepen self-love. Paired in a set of two, these stones symbolize the energetic bond between two people, continuously attracting love and connection.

How to Use:

  • Place two lodestones near a pink or red candle, anointed with our Heart Opener Oil.
  • Write your name and your partner’s name (or ideal partner’s qualities) on a small piece of paper and place it under the lodestones.
  • Light the candle and visualize a strong, loving connection forming.
  • Keep the lodestones together after the ritual to maintain the magnetic energy of love.

Lodestones & Protection Rituals – Deflect Negativity & Stay Grounded
Lodestones don’t just pull in what you desire—they also shield and deflect unwanted energy, making them a powerful tool for protection and energetic cleansing. Combined with our Triple Protection Oil, a lodestone and a black candle create a protective field that absorbs and neutralizes negativity.

How to Use:

  • Anoint a black or white candle with Triple Protection Oil and place it next to your lodestone.
  • Write down any fears, negative influences, or energy blockages on a small piece of paper and burn it in the candle flame.
  • Keep the lodestone on your altar or near your front door for ongoing protection.
